hook.name: BabyAIHook
hook.description: Charges a 3.33% fee on both buys and sells of a fixed AI/BAI pair, always denominated in the AI (quote) token. Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient via poolManager.take(); after each swap, a capped-gas call to creditHolders() on the recipient distributes accumulated fees to holders, triggered at most once per minute.
